examples: Start work on a repository you have not checked out yet, straight from the app.
how_to: Choose New Project, then clone from github.
Paste the repository URL and pick where it goes. It clones, and the folder becomes a project you can start sessions in.

media.alt: The new project dialog listing start empty, clone from github and open an existing folder
media.caption: The new project dialog, with clone from github

name: Clone a project
summary: clone an existing project into a new folder to start a fresh copy of it.
where: The + at the top of the agents drawer, then New Project, then clone from github.
